milestone: Builder's own preview no longer lies about a Free-hosted 'background' image's real compiled z-order
slice: A user disputed the claim that Publish honours the center pane, with screenshots: Builder's Runtime Preview showed a real Scene correctly (frame, ribbon, heart icon, title, watermark all visible), while root Studio showed a completely blank cream/tan rectangle for the SAME World -- even though the Object Strip still listed every object as present. Two synthetic reproductions (single-Place with a Frame; a 6-Place Gallery-template Scene) both rendered correctly in Studio, contradicting the report -- so the user's real, uploaded .vtheme file was requested and traced directly. The real file's compiled theme.layerPack revealed a zero-Holder Scene with 7 Layer Pack entries: one full-bleed (rect {0,0,1,1}) image, decoded and visually confirmed to be a cream/tan aged-paper texture literally named 'Cover - bg - Experience,' compiled to target:'overlay' (drawn dead LAST, on top of everything); the other 6 entries -- a picture frame, a tape clip, three text pieces, and a heart-shaped decoration -- all compiled to target:'slide' (drawn FIRST, underneath). Root cause, confirmed by reading tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/builder.js's convergeSceneLayer (const target = layer.hostedByScene===true ? 'slide' : (layer.kind==='fill' && isFullBleed ? 'slide' : 'overlay')): the compiled z-index bucketing is driven entirely by an Experience's Hosted-By setting (Scene vs. Free), completely independent of its actual position in the authored Scene Stack. In this real Theme, the Theme Author left the ONE Experience meant to be a background as Free-hosted while leaving all 6 foreground decorations Scene-hosted -- backwards from the design's own intent, but with zero warning anywhere, because tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/engineRuntime.js's render(ctx,graph) painted graph.stack in pure raw authored order with NO consideration of hostedByScene/full-bleed-fill bucketing at all -- a genuine, confirmed Fidelity gap between Builder's own Working View/Runtime Preview and what the compile step actually produces. A Theme Author who puts a Free-hosted image at the bottom of their Scene Stack (the natural way to intend a background) sees it render correctly, behind everything, in Builder's own preview -- then discovers, only after Publishing, that it draws dead last and buries everything else, since Free-hosted content ALWAYS compiles to the overlay bucket regardless of stack position. Fixed by teaching render() to bucket its OWN paint order to match convergeSceneLayer's target computation exactly (a new _isBackgroundLayer(layer) helper, mirrored byte-for-byte against the compile step's own isFullBleed/hostedByScene check): background-classified Layers paint first, Holders/Places keep their own original relative order in the middle, every other Layer paints last -- reordering PAINT ONLY via a local array built fresh on every call, never mutating graph.stack itself, so hit-testing (worldBuilderApp.js's mousedown handler, which reads ProjectModel.sceneStack directly, a completely separate source) is unaffected. Verified via a decisive git-stash A/B Playwright reproduction built directly from the real .vtheme's own exact configuration (a Free-hosted full-bleed background Layer plus a Scene-hosted foreground Layer, at the real file's own relative stack positions): the UNMODIFIED baseline showed the foreground correctly on top (matching the user's own Builder screenshot, but silently diverging from what Studio would actually produce); the FIXED code shows the background now correctly painting last/on top in Builder's own preview too -- an honest, truthful match for Studio's real overlay-target behaviour, giving a Theme Author immediate, correct visual feedback to switch that one Experience's Hosted-By setting to Scene, rather than a silent surprise only discoverable after Publish. This fix makes Builder's preview truthful going forward; it does not retroactively repair the real Theme's own already-authored Hosted-By choice -- that remains an authoring fix the Theme Author must make (switching the Cover-bg Experience to Hosted by Scene), now with correct, honest Working View feedback to guide it. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2, 30/30 each) and every existing Rotation/Shapes/Text-fidelity Playwright suite (image rotation, text rotation, text rotation pivot, stretch fit, text alignment fidelity, text newline fix) pass completely unchanged, confirming zero regression -- none of them exercise multi-layer z-order bucketing, so none were affected by this fix. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; tools/world-builder/ (v1) is untouched, since v1 has no Experience/hostedByScene concept of its own to carry this bug; confined to one function, render(), plus one new helper, _isBackgroundLayer(), in tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/engineRuntime.js.
